newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: TENNIS-KRAJICEK TO FACE RAOUX IN ROSMALEN FINAL.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-KRAJICEK TO FACE RAOUX IN ROSMALEN FINAL.

text.p: Defending Wimbledon champion Richard Krajicek will face French qualifier Guillaume Raoux in Sunday's final of the $500,000 Heineken Trophy grasscourt tournament.
Dutchman Krajicek on Saturday beat top-seeded American Michael Chang in three sets, 6-7 6-4 6-3 in a match which was stopped for two hours due to rain.

Raoux was handed his semifinal 6-0 6-1 by fourth seeded Swede Jonas Bjorkman, who was not pleased to be playing in damp conditions in front of hardly any spectators with a Grand Slam tournament just two days away.
The hard-hitting Krajicek showed he is in form ahead of Wimbledon. His service-volley game went well and he did not lose a single service game throughout the tournament.
Krajicek earlier in the tournament indicated he did not fancy playing the final here, so close to Wimbledon.
But after his semi-final he explained that he found it better to prepare in the calm of a small tournament in his home country rather than to move to London early.
"I am the defending champion and in London people will follow me. It might work more distracting than playing here being backed by a fabulous crowd," Krajicek said.
